messages:
raj: kicked off tinybench candidate sweep overnight — focusing on seqlen=8,64,512 across avx2/h100. included kv-cache warm/cold toggles.
amanda: nice. which kernel candidates are in the run?
raj: k_17,k_42,k_88,k_99. also added a new microprobe to stress the matmul tiling path.
perf-bot: nightly tinybench results (summary):
- k_42: -12.3% throughput @ seqlen=512 on avx2 (regression)
- k_17: +5.1% latency @ seqlen=8 on h100 (win)
- k_88: -0.8% at seqlen=64 (noise)
- k_99: +2.2% throughput overall (kv-cache warm path)
perf-bot: raw csv: kernel,seqlen,arch,metric,delta
k_42,512,avx2,throughput,-12.3
k_17,8,h100,latency,-5.1
k_88,64,avx2,throughput,-0.8
k_99,64,h100,throughput,+2.2
chris: ouch k_42 is the tiling kernel we suspected. reproducer?
raj: repro cmd:
``
./run_tinybench --kernel=k_42 --seqlen=512 --arch=avx2 --kv-cache=warm --trials=50
```
kyle: looking at perf flamegraph, the slowdown is in tiled-matmul->packA step. probably bad cacheline alignment when seq>256.
amanda: could be an interaction with our batching heuristic too — if batch size picks 1 for long seq it disables some fusing.
chris: also seeing higher L2 misses on avx2 for k_42 when seqlen=512. KV cold/warm toggles show cold start is actually fine; warm path regresses more.
raj: proposed actions:
- open kernel PR to try smaller tile size + packed layout -> @kyle
- add a microprobe that forces packA cacheline patterns -> @amanda
- gate candidate k_42 in nightly CI until we have PR -> @chris
kyle: I'll draft the PR. also suggest update autotuner to prefer alternative kernel for avx2 when seqlen>256 instead of the default.
amanda: I'll add the microprobe and a targeted unit that simulates batching heuristics with small and large batches.
chris: gating note: add a perf CI rule: if throughput regression >5% at any seqlen on any prod arch, mark candidate as blocked. cheers.
perf-bot: created gist with full artifacts: https://perf.internal/gist/1746123456/tinybench_artifacts
raj: thanks. let's circle on this in tomorrow's perf sync. cc @sre-bot for infra noise.
perf-bot: alert: nightly-run finished in 3h12m, retained 7 artifact bundles :thumbsup: 
amanda: ack. will post PR link once microprobe lands.
kyle: 👍
chris: 👍
